purpose: Localise whether exact-key last-write dominance on prepared02 comes from the shared-depth convex mean, write position/recency, erase/decay/gate dynamics or downstream value readout, without training the frozen rejected writer.
hypothesis: Holding prepared02 observations, candidate identity, candidate vectors and scoring fixed, per-depth proposals or a declared write-position/gate control will recover exact observed-key value recovery only if that update dynamic is the first cause. Query-derived addressing is scored separately and is not expected to explain stored-value loss.

writer_extension.role: frozen rejected writer diagnostic artifact; no optimizer and no weight update may run

guard.compatibility: Uses the existing exclusive MPS worker and fallback-off 50 GiB capacity guard unchanged; the parent guard must list this entry point.

order: query-key value recovery failure before downstream readout
exact-key-specific failure when query-key value recovery passes
decision_rule.first_failure: An earlier isolated control cannot be skipped for a later one; mechanical failure invalidates the run instead of selecting a mechanism.
decision_rule.isolation: A mechanism is named only when its control passes the exact-key upper-bound gate and improves over shared_mean/full by at least the declared top1, rank or margin delta. Query-key value recovery must fail before downstream value_write_or_readout is named; if it passes while exact-key recovery fails, the result is exact_observed_key_read_path.
decision_rule.no_repair_without_evidence: The report names only the smallest next diagnostic change; no writer, reader or addressing training is justified by this package.

limitations: Exact observed-key recovery is a storage upper bound, not addressing capability.
Query-derived addressing is scored separately and must read the raw query key, not a state-derived value; it does not validate useful memory or generation.
Write-position ablations are evaluator-side interventions on observed records, not new writer inputs or training examples.
Reversed order is valid only inside observation-day groups; corrections remain last so supersession semantics are preserved.

forced_full_erase, forced_full_decay, forced_full_gate and forced_full_forget force their named erase/decay/write-gate factors to one; they do not literally remove erasure, decay, gating or forgetting and must not be reported that way.
correction_top1_floor, unaffected_top1_floor and unknown_false_recall_max are explicitly report_only; no mechanism decision consumes them.
The frozen rejected v5 writer remains rejected; no optimizer, checkpoint or capability claim is made.
CPU tiny-adapter tests establish contracts and scoring, not native model quality.
The capacity guard entry-point allowlist is owned by the main integration agent.
